spans.s: मुच [muca] चु [cu] कुन्दः [kundḥ], (चु) कुन्दः 1 N. of a tree (Pterospermum Suberifolium).

N. of an ancient king, son of Māndhātṛi. [For having assisted the gods in their wars with the demons he got, as a reward, the boon of long and unbroken sleep. The gods also decreed that whosoever dared to interrupt his sleep should be burnt to ashes. When Kṛiṣṇa wanted to kill the mighty Kālayavana, he cunningly decoyed him to the cave of Muchukunda, and on his entering it, he was burnt down by the fire which emanated from the king's eye.]-Comp. -प्रसादकः an epithet of Kṛiṣṇa.
मुचिलिन्दः [mucilindḥ], A kind of tree and flower; see मुचकुन्द.
मुचुलिन्दः [muculindḥ], A kind of big orange;
Ā. (मोचते) To deceive, cheat; see मुञ्च्. -
U. (मुञ्चति-ते, मुमोच-मुमुचे, अमुचत्-अमुक्त, मोक्ष्यति-ते, मोक्तुम्, मुक्त]
To loose, set free, release, let go, let loose, liberate, deliver (from captivity &c.); वनाय... यशोधनो धेनुमृषेर्मुमोच
'let not thy limbs droop', 'do not despond'.
To set free, loosen (as the voice); कण्ठं मुञ्चति बर्हिणः समदनः
'loosens his throat or voice' i. e. raises a cry.
To leave, abandon, quit, give up, lay aside, relinquish; रात्रिर्गता मतिमतां वर मुञ्च शय्याम्
; मुनिसुताप्रणयस्मृतिरोधिना मम च मुक्तमिदं तमसा मनः Ś.6.7; मौनं मुञ्चति किं च कैरवकुले
To set apart, take away, except. See मुक्त्वा.
To cast, throw, hurl, fling, discharge; मृगेषु शरान् मुमुक्षोः
To emit, drop, pour forth or down, shed, let fall (tears &c.); अपसृतपाण्डुपत्रा मुञ्चन्त्यश्रूणीव लताः Ś.4.12; चिरविरहजं मुञ्चतो बाष्पमुष्णम्
To be loosed or released, be freed or absolved from (with abl. or instr.); मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः &c.
To abandon, deviate or swerve from. -Caus. (मोचयति-ते)
To cause to be freed or liberated.
To loose, set at liberty, liberate.
To wish to free or liberate &c.
(मुमुक्षते, मोक्षते) To long for final emancipation.
मुच् [muc], a. (At the end of comp.)
